# 在 Waiver schema validation 段开头替换/补充
if ($s.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "waivers" -and $null -ne $s.waivers) {
$requiredFields = @("reason","risk","replacement_evidence","expires")
$w = $s.waivers

if ($w -is [array]) {
foreach ($item in @($w)) {
if ($item -is [string] -or $item -is [int] -or $item -is [bool]) {
$errors.Add("waiver_incomplete: '$item' must be an object with reason/risk/replacement_evidence/expires, not a simple value")
continue
}
foreach ($rf in $requiredFields) {
if ($item.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains $rf) {
$errors.Add("waiver_incomplete: array waiver missing '$rf'")
}
}
}
}
elseif ($w -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) {
foreach ($wn in $w.PSObject.Properties.Name) {
$wv = $w.$wn
if ($null -eq $wv -or $wv -is [string] -or $wv -is [int] -or $wv -is [bool]) {
$errors.Add("waiver_incomplete: '$wn' must be an object with reason/risk/replacement_evidence/expires, not a simple value")
continue
}
foreach ($rf in $requiredFields) {
if ($wv.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains $rf) {
$errors.Add("waiver_incomplete: '$wn' missing '$rf'")
}
}
}
}
}
